summary: A Yes vote adopts a one percent sales (transactions and use) tax in the City of Mount Shasta, providing approximately $1.5 million annually for general government use until ended by voters.

tax.text: A Yes vote on Measure H approves a one percent local sales tax increase in Mt. Shasta to pay for city services such as fire protection, police patrols and street maintenance.
tax.quote: voters will be asked to consider Measure H, a one-cent local sales tax increase to help maintain essential City services.
